title: dispatch gives a host worker only the scratch directory, so it cannot read the plugin's role file its brief names (second-project run)
goal: A worker dispatch starts for a project whose role file is the plugin's agents/worker.md can read that file: dispatch adds the plugin root to the session's --add-dir when the brief names the plugin's role file, with no setting the host must add

run: import subprocess,sys,tempfile; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import backlog, bl_dispatch as d; from bl_base import load_settings; host=tempfile.mkdtemp(); subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',host],check=True); load_settings(host); bl=backlog.Backlog(host); bl.items['TK-aaaaaaaa']={'id':'TK-aaaaaaaa','kind':'task'}; a=d.claude_argv(bl,'TK-aaaaaaaa'); print(a[a.index('--add-dir')+1:a.index('--max-turns')]); sys.exit(0 if str(d.PLUGIN_ROOT) in a else 1)

import pathlib,subprocess,sys,tempfile; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import backlog, bl_dispatch as d; from bl_base import load_settings; host=tempfile.mkdtemp(); subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',host],check=True); (pathlib.Path(host)/d.ROLE_FILE).parent.mkdir(parents=True); (pathlib.Path(host)/d.ROLE_FILE).write_text('role', encoding='utf-8'); load_settings(host); bl=backlog.Backlog(host); bl.items['TK-aaaaaaaa']={'id':'TK-aaaaaaaa','kind':'task'}; a=d.claude_argv(bl,'TK-aaaaaaaa'); sys.exit(1 if str(d.PLUGIN_ROOT) in a else 0)

clauses.clause: A worker dispatch starts for a project whose role file is the plugin's agents/worker.md can read that file: dispatch adds the plugin root to the session's --add-dir when the brief names the plugin's role file, with no setting the host must add

notes: Run finding 10: the worker exited 0 with no commit, result.json permission_denials: [{tool_name: Read, file_path: <plugin>/agents/worker.md}]; fixed for the run only by the host's .claude/settings.json permissions.additionalDirectories naming the plugin root. Blocks the Nerthus workspace adoption (BG-42dg5ryi's host); raised to P1 by the operator. Planned: the filed repro read the source text of claude_argv for the name PLUGIN_ROOT, which a comment would satisfy; rewritten to build a planted host (a git-init directory with no .claude/agents/kb-worker.md) and call bl_dispatch.claude_argv. Ran it: --add-dir holds only the scratch directory, PLUGIN_ROOT absent, exit 1. The fix is in claude_argv (_tools/bl_dispatch.py:575): add PLUGIN_ROOT to the dirs when role_file_line (line 460) names the plugin's file, i.e. when the project has no ROLE_FILE. Referrers: claude_argv is called once, bl_dispatch.py:914; the claude_argv of agent_bench.py and kb_ask.py are separate functions; role_file_line is named in kb/_self/backlog.md:325. Docs: kb/_self/tools.md dispatch row (names the argv --add-dir SCRATCH) and kb/_self/backlog.md:326 (the scratch --add-dir part of the brief) map to bl_*.py. Guard check: a project with its own role file gets no plugin root.
